build.beforeDevCommand: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location (Join-Path $PWD.Path '..') -ErrorAction Stop; if(-not (Test-Path logs)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory logs -Force | Out-Null }; try { $c=New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient; $c.Connect('127.0.0.1',8000); $c.Close(); Write-Output 'TAURI_SRV_READY backend already up'; exit 0 } catch {}; if(-not (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)){ Write-Error 'python not in PATH'; exit 1 }; $out=(Resolve-Path logs).Path+'\backend_stdout.log'; $err=(Resolve-Path logs).Path+'\backend_stderr.log'; $p=Start-Process -FilePath python -ArgumentList 'main.py' -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err; $ts=Get-Date; do { if($p.HasExited){ Write-Error ('backend exited code='+$p.ExitCode+' see logs\backend_stdout.log'); exit 1 }; if((Get-Date)-$ts -gt [timespan]::FromSeconds(25)){ try { $p.Kill() } catch {}; Write-Error 'backend timed out'; exit 1 }; try { $c2=New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient; $c2.Connect('127.0.0.1',8000); $c2.Close(); Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; Write-Output 'TAURI_SRV_READY backend up pid='$p.Id; exit 0 } catch { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400 } } while($true)"
